Name: Train Replacer - the train from the Alvvays Many Mirrors music video
Author: jamesd444
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
This mod replaces the passing train with the colourful train featured in the Many Mirrors music video, animated by Stardew Valley’s own ConcernedApe.

Seeing as ConcernedApe brought a little of his world to Alvvays, it seemed only right to bring a little of theirs back to the valley. If you're anything like me, you've been patiently waiting for someone to come along and add this train to Stardew Valley so that the game can become the all-in-one ConcernedApe-verse that it really ought to be. Well, since no one else has done it, here you go.

For Alvvays fans, admirers of the video, or anyone who thinks the valley could use a slightly more psychedelic train.

[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
Just download, extract and copy the folder into your Stardew Valley mods folder.

[size=4][b]Incompatabilities[/b][/size]
Any other mod that replaces the sprite for the train.

[size=4]AI assistance disclaimer[/size]
Flagged as AI assisted, as a zero-experience modder I used AI as a resource to learn exactly how to go about replacing a vanilla sprite.

[b][size=4]Credits[/size][/b]
Many Mirrors is by Alvvays, with music video animation by ConcernedApe. All credit for the original artwork and design goes to its creators.
